company.name: Seneca Systems
company.shortDescription: Seneca Systems provides next-generation software purpose-built for government.
company.description: Seneca Systems is a provider of purpose-built software for government workers. The company is pioneering constituent service-centered software for government with Romulus, its flagship constituent services platform (CSP). Romulus centralizes constituent communications, organizes service requests, and provides insights into constituent preferences and work performed. Customers across the country depend on Romulus, including offices in Chicago, Houston, Baltimore, Sacramento, San Rafael, and many more.
